title: Breadcrumbs
brief: A breadcrumb trail with three links and a current page. Links underline on hover and show a ring on focus; the current page is bold plain text.

inspiration.note: Took the pattern of linked ancestors followed by a non-link current page; we used chevron separators and a bold current item.
Took the underline on hover idea and the clear focus outline; colours and spacing are ours.
